Resolves #21618

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613

Adds `examples/scheduler/barRenderer`, an eight-press print shop schedule across three days (`2026-11-09` to `2026-11-12` UTC) with 40 print runs backed by `Neo.data.Store` (`PressModel`) and `Neo.timeline.store.Events` (`PrintJobModel`). Each job derives its status (`on-time`, `at-risk`, `late`) from completion progress (`percentDone`) and customer deadline (`dueDate`) via `PrintJobModel`'s calculated `status` field. The custom `barRenderer` applies the status class, renders non-colour status carriers (`✓` for `on-time`, `◆ At risk` with dashed border, `▲ Late` badge), and adds a second line (`customer · quantity · %`) alongside the engine's `.neo-timeline-bar-progress` fill, while a custom-styled `Plain bars` toggle button (`Neo.button.Base` `pressed`) switches `scheduler.barRenderer` on and off live without reloading.

**Catalog record for #21613:**
- `id`: `'scheduler-bar-renderer'`
- `name`: `'Bars that say more'`
- `feature`: `'Progress inside each bar, and a renderer that colours by status and adds a second line'`
- `lookFor`: `'Find the late jobs by colour and glyph. Switch to plain bars and back to see what the renderer adds.'`
- `cover`: The plan with all three states on screen (`barrenderer-1440x900-dark.jpg`).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + guards ran`

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E `BarRenderer.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine` CI + headless Chromium `1440 × 900` & `390 × 844` dark/light renders, WCAG 2.1 contrast measurements, and swapped-order cold-look evaluation) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-7). Residual: none for #21618; batch catalog publication lives in #21613.

## Deltas from ticket

- Carried distinct non-colour indicators across all three states (`✓`, `◆ At risk` + dashed border, `▲ Late`) rather than only `Late` so monochrome and colour-vision-deficient readers can separate `On time` from `At risk` as well as `Late`.
- Fixed `timeAxis.now` outside the seeded November window (`'2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'`) so the live wall-clock `.neo-timeline-now` line does not cut randomly across the schedule.
- Noted an out-of-scope engine re-entrancy finding in `defect-note` `MESSAGE:2ba8b461` (`src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs:419` `passSizeToBody` when `scheduler.resourceColumns` is reassigned after mount; `#21619` heads-up).

Frame critique: Whole-surface verdict is `BETTER` vs `scheduler/basic` on both desktop (`1440 × 900`: `9.0 / 10` vs `6.0 / 10`) and mobile (`390 × 844`: `8.5 / 10` vs `5.5 / 10` & `4.0 / 10`). Cold-read Round 1 and Round 2 surfaced five actionable defects, all fixed before opening: (1) added non-colour status differentiation across all three states (`✓` on `on-time`, `◆ At risk` badge + dashed border on `at-risk`, `▲ Late` badge on `late`), (2) replaced thick `border-left` corner stepping with uniform `1px` borders plus an inset `3px` status stripe and `2.5px` bottom progress rail, (3) muted the three status legend swatches when `Plain bars` is active, (4) normalized `Lightbox backlit` casing, and (5) fixed the light-theme `Press` corner header text contrast (`rgb(15, 23, 42)` on light slate, pinned in `BarRenderer.spec.mjs`). Retained intentional trade-offs: `Plain bars` preserves the engine's untouched default `.neo-timeline-bar` styling (`border-left` accent and default label colour) so the toggle demonstrates exactly what `barRenderer` adds; the vertical progress-fill edge crosses behind mid-word text on ~32%–55% runs while maintaining `8.35 : 1` to `17.22 : 1` contrast on both halves; and far-right timeline overflow scrolls horizontally without a persistent scrollbar overlay.

### 📋 Required Actions

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1:** Let the Plain-bars `Button` own its toggle state.
  - **What happens at `2e6a73fc3f`:** the button renders `role="switch"` with both `aria-checked` and `aria-pressed`, and `aria-pressed` is not a supported state on `role="switch"`. One toggle also drops the button's own `pressed` and `icon-left` classes.
  - **Why:** `afterSetPlainBars` writes `toggle.pressed`, then replaces `toggle.cls` wholesale, and then `syncSwitchAria` writes `role` and `aria-checked` into the child's `vdom`.
  - **Fix:** pick one owner and change the button with one `toggle.set({...})`. Either:
    - keep toggle-button semantics: `pressed` alone gives the engine's `pressed` class and `aria-pressed` (`syncAriaPressedState` in `src/button/Base.mjs`). Style `.print-plain-switch.pressed`, drop `syncSwitchAria` and the `cls` replacement, and assert `aria-pressed` in the spec; or
    - declare switch semantics: give the button `role: 'switch'` as a config, so the Button removes `aria-pressed` itself, and write `aria-checked` in one place.
